correctness.rationale: The Legendre addition theorem reduces ranks to the 12 x 12 Gram. Exact three-relation decomposition includes a universal degree-two polynomial identity on the residual six-dimensional sector. Rational-quadratic certificates check every degree through 199, exact low-degree ranks, sharp degree-14 eigenvalues and all finite spectral gaps. The classical Bernstein bound and Gershgorin prove strict positive spectra and condition bounds in every degree >= 200; finite computations are not used as infinite extrapolation.
